items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: doing some of Bessie Smith's songs and -- for him. He was singing them

ctx.x: So anyway, this particular day we were making those records. We were doing -- I remember this so well, we were
doing some of Bessie Smith's songs and -- for him. He was singing them -- 'What's the Matter Now, you been a good old rag, and she done broke down and some of these things. You got those listed?
I got -- yeah, 'What's the Matter Now, 'I want every bit of it'--
